# mimecast_threat_reporting_subscriptions (Data Source)

Read every threat-reporting subscription without exposing client-state secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_threat_reporting_subscriptions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable threat-reporting subscription inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `creation_date_time` (String) Subscription creation time.
- `expiration_date_time` (String) Subscription expiration time.
- `id` (String) Threat-reporting subscription ID.
- `notification_url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook notification URL when returned by Mimecast.
- `resource_type` (String) Subscribed resource type.
